title: From machine learning to chemical insight: Darwinian chance and the stability of charge carriers in flow batteries
highlight: ML-driven insight into the stability of charge carriers in flow batteries. Published as a 2026 Journal of Materials Chemistry A Advance Article with J. Zhang, Robertson, Shkrob, and Assary.

title: Automation-Accelerated Electrolyte Design Mitigates Solubility Competition between Redox-Active Molecules and Supporting Salts
highlight: 2025 follow-up to the Nature Comm robotic platform — automated HTE + ML for paired BTZ/LiTFSI solubility (~3 M, surpassing the 2 M ceiling). With Robertson, Doan, Han.

title: A comparative computational and SECM study of factors influencing electron transfer at hydrogenated and pristine graphite-propylene carbonate interface
highlight: 2025 SECM + computational study showing H-functionalization on graphitic electrodes increases electron-transfer kinetics. With Curtiss, Assary, Counihan, Rodríguez-López, J. Zhang.

title: An integrated high-throughput robotic platform and active learning approach for accelerated discovery of optimal electrolyte formulations
highlight: Robotic platform + ML for electrolyte discovery — bridging chemistry and AI.

title: Radical Compatibility with Nonaqueous Electrolytes and Its Impact on an All-Organic Redox Flow Battery
highlight: Most-cited paper. Foundational radical-cation work for non-aqueous flow batteries.

title: Molecular engineering towards safer lithium-ion batteries: a highly stable and compatible redox shuttle for overcharge protection
highlight: First-author EES paper on overcharge-protection redox shuttles — basis for R&D 100 Award (2014).

title: The lightest organic radical cation for charge storage in redox flow batteries
highlight: Systematic molecular trimming to find the smallest stable radical-cation core. Featured in Argonne Today.
